title: An awaiting-approval engine run whose ledger went stale shows as stale, dimmed, with a frozen age

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S31 (2026-10-26, owner screenshots): the S78 engine run ork-20261025-175709-e8c9 is awaiting-approval in the daemon (ork status --json), but slicer marked its ledger run run-20261025-175710-49a6 stale after hours without updates. Overview's Approve row reads '+ ork-20261025-175709-e8c9  S78  stale  owner approval  23m': dimmed like a dead run, the word stale, and an age frozen at 23m although it has waited about 19 h. Selecting it shows only the summary strip. The owner cannot tell it is still approvable. The ledger heartbeat (S70) stops while the engine waits for the owner, so every approval that waits more than slicer's stale threshold looks dead.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner to pick at preflight: (a) the engine state wins over the ledger state for an engine-linked run, so it shows 'awaiting approval' with the wait age (recommended), or (b) keep the heartbeat going while the engine waits on the owner so the ledger never goes stale. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui ./internal/source ./internal/engine; goldens; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
